name: Forti VPN
description:
Connect to a Fortinet SSL-VPN from the top bar with one click.

* Several profiles: switch between accounts and gateways from the menu
* OTP: save your secret and the code is made for you, or type it when you connect
* Passwords and OTP secrets are kept in the GNOME Keyring
* Safe DNS: VPN DNS first, your normal DNS stays as backup, everything restored on disconnect
* Live connection steps and notifications

Needs openfortivpn and a small root helper (not part of this zip). Easiest: install the forti-gnome .deb package from the project page, it installs everything. Manual: sudo apt install openfortivpn ppp pkexec gir1.2-secret-1, then install the 3 helper files as shown in the project README (Manual install).

Not supported: push-only 2FA and SAML/SSO logins.
